name: Should I replace or refinish my existing bathtub during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace or refinish my existing bathtub during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to replace or refinish your bathtub depends on its current condition, material, and your budget. Refinishing is a more cost-effective option for tubs that are structurally sound but have cosmetic flaws like stains, chips, or dullness. It involves applying a new coating that can extend the tub's life and improve its appearance. Replacing the tub is necessary if it has significant damage, leaks, or if you want a different size, shape, or material, such as switching from a standard tub to a freestanding model or a walk-in shower. A professional assessment can help determine the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refinish your bathtub if it's structurally sound with cosmetic flaws; replace it if there's significant damage, leaks, or if you desire a different size, shape, or material.
